messages:
maria-collections: Heads-up: Nebula Labs (acct NL-412) invoice INV-20901 is 48 days past due. Card on file expired and ACH bounce logged. We sent reminder + final notice; no reply. Can we do a structured plan to avoid suspension? @tim-sales can you confirm if AM thinks they're staying?

billing-bot: Dunning: 4th notice sent to ap@nebulalabs.ai (attempted at 1773501723). Delivery: delivered.

tim-sales: Talked with their CFO today. They're on a delayed funding cycle; want to keep prod running while they sort it. Ask from them: 90-day glide path (4 payments) and to avoid suspension provided first payment clears. They prefer ACH; they'll need our bank details and an invoice copy with PO number.

sam-finops: Proposed terms from finance: 4-installment plan over 90 days with ACH mandate + one-time 1% recon fee (waivable). Terms: ```- Balance: $62,100 (INV-20901) - Payments: 25% due immediately, then 25% @30d, 25% @60d, 25% @90d - Require signed payment agreement + ACH authorization - Waive service suspension while plan active and payments remain current - Late fee: 1.5% monthly on missed installments - Reconciliation: attach detailed usage CSV```

Need @olivia-fmgr approval to waive recon fee and hold suspension. Also please loop in Legal for ACH authorization verbiage.

olivia-fmgr: Approve the 90-day plan and hold on suspension while active. Waive the 1% recon fee if they provide a valid PO within 48 hours and sign the ACH auth. No fee waiver without PO + signature.

maria-collections: I'll draft the plan and the ACH form. tim-sales 12 can you get their PO and confirm AP contact? I'll create payment_plan_id `PP-17735-NL` and set portal expiry to 5 days.

tim-sales: Confirmed PO# NL-PO-558 coming from CFO; AP contact ap@nebulalabs.ai. I'll send intro email and ask for e-sign today.

maria-collections: Drafted payment agreement and ACH mandate, uploaded to DocuSign. Portal link: https://pay.redwood.ai/pp/PP-17735-NL (expires 5d). Scheduled payments if signed: 2026-04-10 (25%), 2026-05-10 (25%), 2026-06-09 (25%), 2026-07-09 (25%).

cassie-legal: Quick note: standard ACH authorization OK. I'll add clause requiring remittance confirmation before first scheduled run. Will review DSIG and return by EOD.

billing-bot: DocuSign envelope sent to ap@nebulalabs.ai & cfo@nebulalabs.ai (1773540000).

tim-sales: Followed up on the call; CFO said they'd e-sign today and upload PO. :crossed_fingers:

maria-collections: Monitoring. I'll mark account to "no suspend while PP active" once signed. If not signed within 5 days we'll auto-escalate to collections and notify Sales leadership.
